description: Get bid modifiers. Common FieldNames: Id, CampaignId, AdGroupId, Type, Level, MobileAdjustment, DesktopAdjustment, DemographicsAdjustment, RetargetingAdjustment, RegionalAdjustment, VideoAdjustment, SmartAdAdjustment, IncomeGradeAdjustment. Use when the user wants the current bid adjustments for device, demographics, or region. Do not use it to change an adjustment; call set_bid_modifiers. Do not use it to add one; call add_bid_modifiers.
